name: Friendly preparation and interrupted-cast feedback
nextAction: Validate with the single PR #308 candidate; no raster production requested.

decisions.proceduralDesignAcceptance: Code-level restrained feedback authorized; device/aesthetic acceptance pending.

reference.exactEntityState: Per-actor transient 0.65s friendly preparation; interrupted event carries actor, target ID, slot and world position.
traitsToPreserve: Compact overhead companion progress from the shared authoritative clock.
Two broken arcs and small Interrupted text for 0.45s; no broad covering rectangle.
Short falling synth/tiny noise release, crowd-rate-limited; preserve existing music and effect recipes.
Retain actor/world anchors and bounded existing FX queue. No damage geometry or timing belongs to the visual.
Future animation adaptation must preserve feedback meaning and pause behavior; no new animation system.

proceduralOwnersAndReasons: Existing health-bar, FX queue and audio synthesis owners; no sprite registry or new animation subsystem.
